question_text: Was Flight Centre hacked in November 2026?
answer_text: Yes, by its own account. Flight Centre says unknown persons may have accessed a significant number of customer records in a third-party hotel booking system used by some of its brands. It says flights and card details were not affected.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Were Flight Centre customers' passport details exposed?
answer_text: For some. Flight Centre says most records hold only names and basic travel information, and a very small percentage may include limited passport details, birth dates, contact details or health information. It has given no numbers.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Which booking system was breached, and were other travel companies affected?
what_would_settle_it: Flight Centre or the supplier naming the system; the supplier or other companies saying whether anyone else that uses it was affected.

question_text: How many Flight Centre customers were affected?
what_would_settle_it: Flight Centre giving a count of records accessed and taken once its investigation with Mandiant is done.

question_text: Who was behind the Flight Centre breach?
what_would_settle_it: Flight Centre, the supplier, law enforcement or a credible independent analysis naming who did it.
